return new SqlRowSource<SalesSummarySqlRow>("OLESRC_OrdersAndDetails", new SqlSourceOptions { ConnectionString = SqlConnectionStringFactory.Build(Db()), CommandText = "SELECT
    o.CustomerID,
    c.FullName,
    c.CleanEmail AS Email,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID) AS TotalOrders,
    SUM(od.Quantity * od.UnitPrice) AS TotalRevenue,
    MAX(o.OrderDate) AS LastOrderDate
FROM dbo.Orders o
INNER JOIN dbo.OrderDetails od ON od.OrderID = o.OrderID
INNER JOIN dbo.StagingCustomers c ON o.CustomerID = TRY_CAST(c.CustomerID AS INT)
WHERE ISNULL(c.IsValidRow, 1) = 1
GROUP BY o.CustomerID, c.FullName, c.CleanEmail" }, SalesSummarySqlRowReader.Read, uow);
